label: Deja el Meta de los presupuestos existentes igual a su Base

execute.description: ítems sin precio Meta propio: su total Meta es el total Base
execute.sql:
UPDATE "public"."ppto_DetalleItems"
                     SET "CostoTotalMeta" = "CostoTotal"
                   WHERE "CostoUnitarioMeta" IS NULL AND "CostoTotalMeta" IS DISTINCT FROM "CostoTotal"

execute.description: subfases con ítems: su Meta es la suma del Meta de sus ítems
execute.sql:
UPDATE "public"."ppto_DetalleFasesCate" c
                     SET "CostoDirectoMeta" = s."total"
                    FROM (
                      SELECT "id_detalle_categoria" AS "id", sum("CostoTotalMeta") AS "total"
                        FROM "public"."ppto_DetalleItems"
                       GROUP BY "id_detalle_categoria"
                    ) s
                   WHERE c."id" = s."id" AND c."CostoDirectoMeta" IS NULL

postcheck.description: ningún ítem sin precio Meta propio queda con un total Meta distinto del Base
postcheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."ppto_DetalleItems"
   WHERE "CostoUnitarioMeta" IS NULL AND "CostoTotalMeta" IS DISTINCT FROM "CostoTotal") AS "result"

postcheck.description: ninguna subfase con ítems queda sin su Meta
postcheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."ppto_DetalleFasesCate" c
   WHERE c."CostoDirectoMeta" IS NULL
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."ppto_DetalleItems" i WHERE i."id_detalle_categoria" = c."id")) AS "result"
